# ✦・ﾟ✧ GingerMonann's SMP ✧ﾟ・✦

**Your favorite ginger made a server. Woo!**

---

![image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/mC4hg59u/images/6a89a6e1b1f2ab9c7bcb31761c5514d2f5f93cce.png)

## About

Welcome to **GingerMonann's SMP**, a community-focused survival server where everyone is welcome. Whether you're building massive bases, exploring the world, or just hanging out with friends, there's always something to do.

Our goal is simple: create a fun, friendly, and optimized Minecraft experience for everyone.

## Features

* 🌎 Crossplay (Java & Bedrock)
* ⚡ Optimized client modpack (50+ performance & QoL mods)
* 🎨 Shader support, minimap, voice chat, and visual improvements
* 🛠️ Vanilla-friendly gameplay with no gameplay-changing mods

## Server Info

**Minecraft Version:** `1.7.2 – 1.21.11`

**Java IP**

```text
ginsmp.com
```

**Bedrock IP**

```text
ginsmp.com
```

**Bedrock Port**

```text
2342
```

## Join Us

Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned veteran, we'd love to have you. Hop online, make some friends, and enjoy the adventure!

See you in-game! 🍪
